sn11.17:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti, paṭisallīno.
sn11.17:1.3: atha kho sakko ca devānamindo brahmā ca sahampatī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu.
sn11.17:1.4: atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
sn11.17:3.1: [bhagavā:] na kho devānaminda tathāgatā evaṃ vanditabbā.
